reasons: en / v-5 — a claim that traces to no element. The sentence ends "Both sit here against total federal net receipts of $5,234.6 billion for fiscal year 2025." It binds to usaid-deficit-panel-scale-check, whose rebuilt denominator is the claim's own asserted size (label "The size the claim asserts, the average guess the poll records for the share of the federal budget going to foreign aid", value 26 percent, source_id en-kff-tracking-feb2025). No element in the artifact carries $5,234.6 billion or any USD figure: the only Value objects are 26, 26, 1, 11, 58 and 34, every one unit percent. The panel it binds to asserts the negation in its own takeaway, "What the panel cannot put on either bar is a dollar amount, because no source in the registry states the line's annual outlay or the budget total the poll's shares are shares of", and the claim map's hidden entry usaid-deficit-hidden-outlay-numerator rules the comparison out explicitly, calling Treasury receipts "a different total from the budget that slice is a share of". So the sentence is not merely unsupported by the rebuilt panel, it is contradicted by two elements of it. The binding resolves; the claim does not trace. Fix: restate the third clause against the 26 percent the claim asserts, so "about 1 percent" reads as a share of the asserted size.

en / sparring.questions[1] (move "denominator") — a claim that traces to no element, carried across three spans of one item, all describing the pre-rebuild panel. The stem asks "The scale check sets the poll's two share figures against one government-wide total. Which total is it?"; the option flagged correct (correct: 2) is "Total federal net receipts for fiscal year 2025, $5,234.6 billion"; the note repeats "The scale check reads both figures ... against total federal net receipts of $5,234.6 billion for fiscal year 2025, from the Treasury statement." The rebuilt scale_check has no government-wide total and no USD value at all; its denominator is 26 percent from en-kff-tracking-feb2025. The item therefore marks as correct an answer that the panel on the same screen refutes, and asks the reader to accept a base the claim map's usaid-deficit-hidden-deficit-base and usaid-deficit-hidden-outlay-numerator both record as unavailable. Fix: rewrite stem, options and note to the asserted-size denominator, or retire the item.
